name: email-format-guard
description: Deterministic pre-send gate for customer-facing email: no long dashes, no formatting in the body, no unresolved placeholders, no team salutations, no double sign-offs. Also scans pipeline code for hard-wired violations.
author: exasyncai

name: decision-precedent
description: Never ask the same question twice: search stored decisions before asking a human, store the answer with rationale, and log whether a precedent was applied. Local JSON store, no cloud required.
author: exasyncai

name: usage-guard
description: Hook that shows your subscription usage in every turn and blocks expensive commands once a threshold is reached, so a long-running session hands over cleanly instead of hitting the wall.
author: exasyncai
